newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ends ahead as Nokia, Metra lure bulls.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ends ahead as Nokia, Metra lure bulls.

text.p: Shares ended a lively Thursday session higher sparked by gains in Nokia and Metra, combined with a firmer opening on Wall Street, brokers said.
Nokia closed official trade up two markka at 189.00, unfazed by Motorola's profit-warning on Wednesday. Volume was healthy in Nokia, at over 105 million markka.
"Semiconductors is Motorola's main problem, it shouldn't have a negative impact on Nokia," one broker said.
Brokers saw scope for further gains in Nokia in the near-term. "I expect the stock to be knocking on 200 (markka) soon," one said.
Engineering group Metra gained sharply on news of a planned merger between its Wartsila diesel unit and Italian Fincantieri's diesel engine operations.

Metra's B shares closed at a two-year high of 248.00 markka, up nine markka or 3.77 percent. The less liquid A series ended up at 14.00 markka at 250.00. Combined volume was brisk for Metra at over 26 million markka.
"Once the market digested the news of the merger, there was rush of buying in the share," one broker said.
